bundle.shortDescription: File converter with a floating radial wheel
bundle.longDescription: Satsuma converts files locally (images, audio, video, documents, PDF, spreadsheets, subtitles and archives) from a radial wheel that appears next to the cursor, and offers tools such as compress, trim, rotate and resize. It uses ffmpeg, ImageMagick, pandoc, LibreOffice, poppler and ghostscript. A macOS port of Mandarina by JorgeFTS (github.com/JorgeFTS/Mandarina), MIT licensed.
